import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    p=params
    L=np.log(P)
    return (p[0]+p[1]*t**2)*P**1.5 + (p[2]+p[3]*t**2)*P + (p[4]+p[5]*t**2)*P**2 + (p[6]+p[7]*t**2)*P*L + (p[8]+p[9]*t**2)*P**2.5
